title: When Compressed CRPS Depends on Measurement Units: An Affine Metamorphic Audit and Stable Correction
description: Reproducibility package for a source-specific CRPS implementation audit. It contains an affine-standardized weighted CRPS wrapper, exact tests, temperature, precipitation, and bike-demand validations, cross-package affine controls, a public source-history audit, runtime comparisons, and the manuscript.
